author: MetaCtrMady123
quote: Because of how hyped the game was, I had high expectations. The scenery was the only thing that delivered honestly. Everything else was horrible. GTA used to be about doing crime, but it feels like the game punishes you when you commit crime the way the devs doesn't want you to. They say you have a choice, but if you don't play it the way they intend on you playing, you'll get a horrible ending. I wont spoil it, but you can check them out online. It's waste your money buying this glitchy game.
